content.short: THEOS is a decentralized hybrid NFT marketplace that delivers a smart contract infrastructure.
content.description:
THEOS is aiming to become the main digital destination for the majority of NFT users. To achieve that, THEOS will provide much more than an NFT marketplace with minting services. This expansion of services that THEOS will offer to its users will be delivered as a set of groundbreaking NFT inventions.

Firstly, the THEOS invention—ODYSSEY pools, will allow users to deposit their NFTs to receive instant liquidity in the form of ODYSSEY tokens. While the NFT is in the pool, anyone will be able to buy it even for a higher price than what was originally received. All users can interact with the pool and withdraw NFTs by burning ODYSSEY tokens of that specific pool - even the original owner of an NFT.

Secondly, DELPHI pools will allow NFTs to be staked. The mechanism will work in the following fashion: a DELPHI pool originator will originate a pool with a specified amount of fungible tokens along with the vesting schedule of token release. Staked NFTs can therefore attain a constant vested amount of liquidity. DELPHI NFTs are basically personal liquidity mining pools: anyone can mint a Delphi NFT, attach an arbitrary pool of ERC20’s and thereafter store, stake, transfer or sell it.

Lastly, THEOS will offer a myriad of NFT utilities that will enable users to get maximal benefits from the non fungible blockchain technology. Some examples of these utilities are drag and drop minting, user friendly UI, various types of auctions, verified NFTs, social media components through which one can ‘like’ NFTs, royalties and much more!

The THEOS system is also capable of using NFTs to facilitate price discovery and transferability of fungible but illiquid assets, such as pre-money project tokens. All these concepts are technological breakthroughs that THEOS brings to the table.

Aside from utilities and technological breakthroughs, THEOS will enable support of ideas that aim to impact our world for the better. Users will be able to create ‘Cause Pools’ that when voted on by the ecosystem, will receive rebates from specific ODYSSEY pools activity. This way, positive social and scientific initiatives will be able to receive funding for their activities.

THEOS’ goal is to lead the NFT revolution field with an innovative approach, expertise and a fully fledged hybrid NFT platform.
